course.name: American Literature and Composition
course.subject: english
course.prerequisite_policy: Configured by course manager; recommended grade range is not a hard restriction.

course_learning_outcomes: Demonstrate mastery of the course's core knowledge and skills.
Apply concepts through structured practice and authentic tasks.
Demonstrate mastery through weekly, module, and final assessments.

weeks.title: Early American Literature: Close reading and annotation
weeks.instructor_overview: Introduce and develop close reading and annotation within the context of Early American Literature. Use explicit instruction, worked examples or models, guided practice, and independent application.
learning_objectives: Identify and explain important features of close reading and annotation.
Support interpretations with specific textual evidence.
Communicate an organized analysis using appropriate academic language.
warm_up: Recall one idea related to close reading and annotation.
Answer a short retrieval question from the previous week.
Write one question you expect this week's lesson to answer.
lesson_content: Introduction to Close reading and annotation
Teacher modeling and guided examples for close reading and annotation
Collaborative practice involving close reading and annotation
Independent application and reflection
